TABLE VII: Failure-mode breakdown of unsuccessful agent patches across 19 PRs. Values count the number of distinct PRs contributing at least one case in any agent’s run.

Values count the number of distinct PRs (of 19) contributing at least one case of that theme in any agent’s run.

TABLE I: Mutation strategies used in test generation.
